title: Partition manifest (schema 1)
description: One per detector pass, written by the runner (never by the agent). `claimed_model` is what the pass reported about itself; `attestation.kind` says how that claim is backed and `attested` is true only for cli-provenance with evidence — see methodology.md → Host attestation. An unattested partition is INCOMPLETE with stop_reason model-identity-unattested; no switch detection is claimed. `result_hash` is the sha256 of the agent's returned bytes; `input_hash` is the sha256 of what the agent read (the Codex context pack), null when the input was the checkout itself.
